annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (Jordan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Eight principles: humanity and society, inclusiveness and justice, privacy and data, transparency, responsibility and accountability, reliability, integrity, and environment/Green AI.
Accountability for AI harms rests with natural persons, not the technical system.
Humans must keep the right to human intervention in AI decisions.
Metaverse principles: avatar disclosure, human control, right to withdraw, child safety.
Compliance is voluntary: awareness, curricula, internal compliance officers, accreditation or awards, and a complaints channel at the Ministry.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Jordan's National Artificial Intelligence Code of Ethics, issued by the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship. It sets out eight voluntary ethical principles for responsible AI, plus metaverse and research-ethics principles, a list of risks of non-compliance, and recommendations to promote compliance. It is a general AI document with no robotics-specific provisions.
